name: tendersai
description: Public procurement tenders, AI tender analysis, tender documents and contract-award data from TendersAI.

interface.longDescription:
TendersAI helps businesses find and assess public procurement tenders. Search tenders from Malta, Europe and other countries by keyword, country, CPV code, category, contracting authority, value and deadline. Open a tender to see its full details and official links, read TendersAI's AI analysis (eligibility criteria, requirements, risk, profitability and complexity scores, and a timeline of key dates), and go through the processed tender documents. Check contract-award history to see which companies win which contracts, from which authorities and at what value. You can also review the tenders you track and add or remove tenders from that list.

Searching tenders works without an account. Full tender details, AI analysis, documents and award data are available to TendersAI accounts that include them. TendersAI does not submit bids, contact contracting authorities or make purchases on your behalf. AI analysis can contain mistakes, so always check the official tender documents, which every result links to.
defaultPrompt: Find open construction tenders in Malta closing in the next 30 days.
Who can bid for the University of Malta outdoor cleaning tender, and what are the key dates?
Which companies have won the most construction contracts in Malta this year?

positive.prompt: Find open construction tenders in Malta that close in the next 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of Maltese tenders with status Issued and a deadline within 30 days, each with the contracting authority, value where published, deadline and a link to the tender page.

positive.prompt: Show me the full details of tender SPD1/2026/058, the University of Malta outdoor cleaning framework contract.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds tender spd1202638 and returns its details: a framework contract for cleaning services and hygiene equipment for the outdoor areas of the University of Malta Msida campus, an estimated value of EUR 357,136, the 2 November 2026 submission deadline and the link to the official notice.

positive.prompt: Get the TendersAI report for tender spd1202638 and tell me who can bid, the key dates and the main risks.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the AI report: eligibility (a valid licence from the Department for Industrial and Employment Relations and compliance with the Employment Agencies Regulations), deadlines (information requests 19 October, submission 2 November 2026), complexity 7/10, risk 5/10, a 24-month framework agreement and the timeline of key dates, with a note to verify against the official documents.

positive.prompt: Which companies won construction contracts in Malta worth more than EUR 1 million, and for how much?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns contract awards for Maltese construction tenders above EUR 1,000,000 with the winning company, award value, award date and tender, plus statistics over all matches (count, total, average and median value).

positive.prompt: Show me the public contract award history of Camray Company Ltd.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the company profile for Camray Company Ltd with its total number of awards and total value, awards per year, the contracting authorities and categories it wins most often, and its awards newest first.

review.commerce_description: TendersAI does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Users with an existing TendersAI account can use the features already included in it.

publication.release_notes: TendersAI for ChatGPT: search public tenders from Malta, Europe and other countries, open full tender details, read TendersAI's AI tender analysis and processed tender documents, search contract awards, check a company's award history, and manage the tenders you track.
